# Generated Configuration Field Reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_config_reference.py. Do not edit directly. -->

This inventory is generated from the checked-in frozen configuration
dataclasses. It is exhaustive for declared field paths and resolved Python
annotations, and it records every scalar default. Short scalar collections are
shown inline; other collection defaults are summarized, with nested dataclass
templates expanded below their container paths. Use the live dump command below
when exact collection contents matter. Loading, precedence, validation
semantics, security handling, and subsystem-specific constraints are normative
in the [Configuration Guide](configuration.md).

Configuration has no hot reload: any change requires construction of a new
Runtime. A unit-bearing name segment supplies the unit only where the table says
so (`_s` seconds, `_ms` milliseconds, `_bytes` bytes, `_chars` characters,
`_tokens` tokens, and `_quanta` scheduler quanta). Fields without a listed unit
are counts, enums, identifiers, paths, policies, ratios, or other values defined
by the guide and typed source.

Exact checked-in baseline defaults can be inspected without opening a Runtime:

```bash
uv run python - <<'PY'
import json
from agent_libos.config import DEFAULT_CONFIG
from agent_libos.utils.serde import to_jsonable

print(json.dumps(to_jsonable(DEFAULT_CONFIG), indent=2, sort_keys=True))
PY
```
